title: Ou Tatiek residents gather outside Battambang provincial court to seek release of detained community representatives
location: Outside Battambang provincial court, Battambang province, Cambodia; residents came from Ou Tatiek village in Samlot district.
scope: One June27 gathering described in CCHR chronology and attributed there to CamboJA. The entry gives an approximate crowd of 100 and release demand; exact underlying article and detailed site response remain to be confirmed. No merging with unrelated land actions in other provinces.
organizer: Ou Tatiek village residents; formal organizer unknown.
participants_original: Approximately 100 residents (CCHR chronology summarizing CamboJA; approximate).
threshold_50_evidence: CCHR chronology reports approximately 100 residents gathered on June27, above threshold though no exact lower/upper bound is stated (turn701867view0 line84). The entry attributes the report to CamboJA at line86; underlying contemporaneous text not yet read.

date.summary: CCHR chronology dates event 27-Jun-2023 (turn701867view0 lines81-84); source publication date and actual action date are not independently available in this entry.

location.summary: About 100 Ou Tatiek residents gathered outside the Battambang provincial court (line84).

organizer.summary: Residents of Ou Tatiek village; named formal organizer not given (line84).

demand.summary: Demanded release of five community representatives and activists held in pretrial detention over the land dispute (line84).

participants.summary: Approximately 100 residents; approximate, no minimum or maximum (line84).

threshold_50.summary: Approx.100 report supports threshold but comes from a secondary timeline explicitly sourcing CamboJA, with no original report yet inspected.

state_response.summary: No conduct by authorities in response to this gathering is described in the timeline. Pretrial detention refers to five representatives held before the gathering, not arrests at the gathering.

notes: Current source supports a plausible ≥50 gathering, state-directed release demand, and June date, but it is an aggregator entry explicitly pointing to CamboJA. Keep pending until the contemporaneous CamboJA body and any relevant episode links are inspected. The separate June8 Kandal airport case is below threshold and is not merged.
